summary.text: Paul Wikstrom is the Republican nominee in Minnesota's 4th Congressional District. An engineering manager from Shoreview, he lost a 2025 special election for Minnesota House District 40B. He says he is running on stopping government fraud, affordability and jobs.

paragraphs.text: Grew up in Montana and North Dakota, and graduated from Dickinson High School, before moving to Minnesota as a young adult.
Earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Minnesota, Twin Cities, and a graduate degree from the University of St. Thomas.
Says he worked in seismic exploration, road construction and farming before becoming an engineer; currently works as an engineering manager.
Says he is a certified flight instructor and active pilot who has flown medical volunteer missions, and coached youth soccer for more than 10 years.
Says he has been a Republican grassroots leader for more than 25 years, convening caucuses, chairing conventions and supporting campaigns; he also says he contested a candidate's eligibility in 2024.
Lost the March 11, 2025 special general election for Minnesota House District 40B to David Gottfried (D), 70.2%-29.8%.
Has been married 30 years and raised three children in Shoreview, Minnesota.
